title: OPSC ASO Curated PYQ Compilation (2014–2025)
subtitle: 50 Verified Selected PYQs • English, GK, Math, Reasoning & Odia

questions.questionText: [OPSC ASO 2015] The notice or announcement of a person's death in a newspaper or periodical is __________.
[OPSC ASO 2019] Let's go for a walk, __________? (Add the right question tag.)
[OPSC AG ASO 2025] It was ________ honour to meet the author.

[OPSC ASO 2015] "Will you attend the meeting?" he said. In reported speech this will be:
options: He asked us whether we would attend the meeting.
We asked us whether he would attend the meeting.
He asked that if we will attend the meeting.
We asked if he will attend the meeting.

questions.questionText: [OPSC AG ASO 2025] Identify the incorrect bracketed part: Neither the manager [nor] his assistant [were] aware of the new regulations, and this [caused] significant confusion [among] the staff.
[OPSC ASO 2019] The politician made false claims and called his honest colleagues corrupt, but when the facts became public, he had to eat his words. What does the last phrase here mean?
options: To say sorry for his mistake
To take back what he said

[OPSC ASO 2019] What is not correct with respect to Olive Ridley Sea Turtles?
options: Gahirmatha is world's largest known nesting and breeding ground of such type of turtles.
Two other mass nesting beaches for such turtles in Odisha are located on the mouth of rivers Rushikulya and Daya.
The eggs of such turtles hatch at night and the hatchlings are highly sensitive to light.
These species are recognised as Vulnerable in the Red List of IUCN.

questions.questionText: [OPSC AG ASO 2025] What happens if the Rajya Sabha suggests Amendments to a money bill?
options: The Lok Sabha is bound to accept them
The Lok Sabha may or may not accept them
The bill is sent to a Joint Session of both the Houses

questions.questionText: [OPSC AG ASO 2025] In Odisha State 'Hexadeltaic region' is named after
options: Six deltaic districts of the State
Six coastal districts of the State
Hexagonal shape of the region in the State

questions.questionText:
[OPSC ASO 2022] Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below:
List-I (Tropical Cyclone) | List-II (Region/Country)
(a) Baguio | (i) China
(b) Cyclone | (ii) Philippines
(c) Hurricane | (iii) Madagascar

options: Repeal of the Vernacular Press Act - 1878

[OPSC ASO 2019] A is B's sister. C is B's mother. D is C's father. E is D's mother. Then, how is A related to D?

[OPSC ASO 2014] A man has Rs. 480 in the denominations of one rupee notes, five rupee notes and ten rupee notes. The number of each denomination is equal. What is the total number of notes that he has?
[OPSC AG ASO 2025] The average of the ages of three persons A, B and C is 45 years and the average age of A, C and D is 51 years. If the age of D is 56 years, what is the age of B?

[OPSC ASO 2015] Choose a correct sequence of ascending order of magnitude for 2¹², 3⁸, 4⁷, 10³ :

[OPSC ASO 2015] Each statement below has three segments. Choose the alternative where the third segment in a statement can be logically deduced using both the preceding two segments.
(i) Some boys are tall; all tall persons are smart; some boys are smart.
(ii) Some boys are tall; some boys are smart; boys are either tall or smart.
[OPSC ASO 2022] Three positions of a dice are given. Find out which number is found opposite the number 2 in the given cube?

[OPSC ASO 2022] David gets on the elevator at the 11th floor of a building and rides up at the rate of 57 floors per minute. At the same time, Albert gets on an elevator at the 51st floor of the same building and rides down at the rate of 63 floors per minute. If they continue travelling at these rates, then at which floor will their paths cross?
[OPSC ASO 2022] In a certain code language, 'VIRTUE' is coded as '201' and 'TRAGEDY' is coded as '218'. How will 'PROFANE' be coded in that language?

[OPSC AG ASO 2025] There are seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F, and G. Each of them has different heights. C is shorter than only G. The number of persons taller than B is equal to the number of persons shorter than D. Neither A nor E is shortest. Who among the following is shortest?
